thread:
Alice.m: Deploy-bot flagged promotion to prod for payments-service v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 as blocked: immutable-values-hash mismatch. Anyone pick this up?

deploy-bot: Promotion paused by policy: valuesHash mismatch between canary and target. See /deploy/logs/5412345678

Sam.k: I saw this — chart changes included a values.yaml that has 'clusterRegionId' set as immutable in template. Helm refuses to patch with change.

Devon: Do we have rollback or pin options? We can either pin to 2.3.1 for prod and promote 2.4.0 later after config migration, or do a manual force upgrade.

Tina: Manual force is risky for DB migrations. There's no migration, but it touches configmap that triggers restarts.

Alice.m: Deploy timeline: we need this promoted in next window (04:00 UTC). Suggest pin and ship release notes with a follow-up plan.

Sam.k: Agree. Also flagging that the change was introduced by a values key rename (region_id -> clusterRegionId). Canary instances already patched.

Devon: Quick fix: backport a cherry-pick that retains old key name, bump chart minor, promote. That would keep behavior identical.

Tina: If we pin, can we set deploy-bot to skip canary and promote 2.3.1 -> 2.3.2 patch with the old key? How do we annotate?

Alice.m: I'll create a release-note line and open a PR for 2.3.2. Action items: Alice create PR, Sam approve, Devon prepare helm patch, Tina schedule manual promote.

Sam.k: ACK. PR: https://github.com/redwood/payments/compare/... I'll approve once CI passes.

Devon: Helm commands I'll run on approve: `helm upgrade payments svc-chart --namespace prod --reuse-values --set image.tag=2.3.2 --wait`

Tina: Deploy-bot will need annotation 'manual-promote: true' — @eng-releases do we want to bypass canary? @deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: To bypass canary, use annotation: deployment.redwood/force-canary-skip=true. Promotion requested by @alice.m will proceed after CI and approvals.

Alice.m: Ok doing PR now. Also adding release note: 'Hotfix: preserve legacy values key to avoid rollout blockers; follow-up will migrate clusters to new key.'

Sam.k: I'll stand by to approve. If CI flakes, ping me in thread.

Devon: If we hit pod-eviction surge, we will roll one AZ at a time. Ops on standby.

Tina: Scheduling manual promote at 03:50 UTC (10 min before window). Anyone object? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

Sam.k: No objections.

Alice.m: Final: pin prod to 2.3.2, annotate manual promote, assemble release notes, post-deploy follow-up to migrate to 2.4.0. I'll update release board.
